evidence_items.explanation: Article 9 requires providers to assume content-producer responsibilities and information-security duties; other articles require correction of unlawful outputs and provide enforcement powers, with application beginning August 15, 2023. These substantial obligations counter a broad worldwide suggestion of scarcely any regulation, although the text does not establish practical effectiveness.

evidence_items.locator: Managing Risks to Safety and Security

receipt.public_excerpt: The Executive Order directed a sweeping range of actions within 90 days to address some of AI's biggest threats to safety and security.

evidence_items.explanation: The statement reports that Defense Production Act authorities had been used to compel reporting of safety-test results by developers of the most powerful systems. It establishes earlier mandatory oversight, but neither a comprehensive October inventory nor evidence that reporting prevented chatbot guardrail failures.
